# baffinbay_ca_bundle (Resource)

Manages a Baffin Bay CA Bundle.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM encoded CA certificate(s).
- `name` (String) The name of the CA bundle.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the CA bundle.
